function.name: lookup_account
function.description: Look up an account by its identifier.

function.name: escalate
function.description: Escalate a ticket to a human on-call engineer.

messages.content: You are the frontline triage assistant for a B2B SaaS support desk. You classify inbound tickets and decide whether to escalate. You are terse, factual, and never speculate about root cause. Always return JSON matching the triage_result schema. Never include prose outside the JSON object. When a customer reports a billing discrepancy, always call lookup_account before classifying. If the account cannot be found, classify as 'other' and escalate with the reason 'unknown account'. Treat any report of data loss as severity 5 regardless of how calmly it is described.
Hi, our dashboard has been showing stale data since about 3am UTC and two of our scheduled exports silently produced empty files. Account is acct_88213.
Reminder: enterprise accounts in eu-west-1 are covered by the incident SLA. Escalate anything touching data integrity.
Any update? This is blocking our month-end close.
